# Prerequisites

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask doctor` from `xtask/src/prereqs.rs`; do not edit by hand. -->

CI runs `cargo xtask doctor --check`, so this page cannot drift from the code. Run
`cargo xtask doctor` to check your machine, `cargo xtask doctor --fix` to install what can be
installed automatically, or `cargo xtask doctor --json` for machine-readable output.

**Required** entries are needed for the core loop and the finish gates; **optional** ones are
for specific workflows. `cargo xtask ci` and `cargo xtask wasm` fail with the fix when a
required prerequisite is missing.

## Core tools

| Prerequisite | Needed for | Install / fix |
|---|---|---|
| `git` | provenance: history, diff, corpus pins (required) | — |
| `cargo` | builds and every `cargo xtask` command (required) | — |

## Rust toolchain

| Prerequisite | Needed for | Install / fix |
|---|---|---|
| `clippy` | the `cargo xtask ci` clippy step (required) | `rustup component add clippy` |
| `rustfmt` | the `cargo xtask ci` format step (required) | `rustup component add rustfmt` |
| `wasm32-unknown-unknown` | the `cargo xtask wasm` gate: L0-L6 must build for the web (required) | `rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown` |
| `rust-analyzer` | editor and MCP semantic navigation (optional) | `rustup component add rust-analyzer` |

## Linux system libraries

| Prerequisite | Needed for | Install / fix |
|---|---|---|
| `pkg-config` | build scripts that probe system libraries (required, linux) | `sudo apt-get install -y pkg-config` |
| `libxkbcommon-dev` | keyboard input (egui/winit) (required, linux) | `sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev` |
| `libwayland-dev` | Wayland backend (required, linux) | `sudo apt-get install -y libwayland-dev` |
| `libx11-dev` | X11 backend (required, linux) | `sudo apt-get install -y libx11-dev` |
| `libxrandr-dev` | X11 monitor info (required, linux) | `sudo apt-get install -y libxrandr-dev` |
| `libxi-dev` | X11 input (required, linux) | `sudo apt-get install -y libxi-dev` |
| `libgl1-mesa-dev` | OpenGL (required, linux) | `sudo apt-get install -y libgl1-mesa-dev` |
| `libgtk-3-dev` | native dialogs (rfd) (required, linux) | `sudo apt-get install -y libgtk-3-dev` |

## Platform build tools

| Prerequisite | Needed for | Install / fix |
|---|---|---|
| `Xcode Command Line Tools` | the macOS C toolchain and linker (required, macos) | `xcode-select --install` |
| `MSVC build tools` | Visual Studio Build Tools (Desktop development with C++) (required, windows) | `install Visual Studio Build Tools with the "Desktop development with C++" workload` |

## Editors, docs and scripts

| Prerequisite | Needed for | Install / fix |
|---|---|---|
| `mdbook` | the `mdbook build book` docs gate (optional) | `cargo install mdbook --version 0.4.52 --locked` |
| `python3` | repo scripts (corpus fixtures, contributor stats, packaging metadata) (optional) | — |

## Data and build inputs

| Prerequisite | Needed for | Install / fix |
|---|---|---|
| `corpus/` | the `cargo xtask test-corpus` gate (fetched on demand; never committed) (optional) | `cargo xtask corpus --all` |
| `../craft-fonts` | optional fonts build input (runs the Japanese font tests) (optional) | `git clone https://github.com/storytold/craft-fonts ../craft-fonts` |
| `curl` | `cargo xtask corpus` downloads the pinned corpora with it (optional) | — |
| `tar` | `cargo xtask corpus` unpacks the pinned corpora with it (optional) | — |

## Web and fuzzing

| Prerequisite | Needed for | Install / fix |
|---|---|---|
| `trunk` | the browser build (`apps/photocraft-web`, `packaging/web`) (optional) | `cargo install trunk --locked` |
| `cargo-fuzz` | the manual fuzz job (needs a nightly toolchain) (optional) | `cargo install cargo-fuzz --locked` |

## Packaging and release

| Prerequisite | Needed for | Install / fix |
|---|---|---|
| `shellcheck` | the packaging shell-script lint (optional) | `sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck` |
| `xmllint` | the packaging XML lint (libxml2-utils) (optional) | `sudo apt-get install -y libxml2-utils` |
| `appstreamcli` | validates the AppStream metadata (optional) | `sudo apt-get install -y appstream` |
| `desktop-file-validate` | validates the .desktop entry (desktop-file-utils) (optional) | `sudo apt-get install -y desktop-file-utils` |
| `resvg` | renders the app icons (`packaging/icons.sh`) (optional) | `cargo install resvg --locked` |
| `flatpak` | builds the Flatpak bundle (optional, linux) | `sudo apt-get install -y flatpak` |
| `flatpak-builder` | builds the Flatpak bundle (optional, linux) | `sudo apt-get install -y flatpak-builder` |
| `librsvg2-common` | the SVG pixbuf loader AppStream icon rendering needs (optional, linux) | `sudo apt-get install -y librsvg2-common` |
| `wix` | builds the Windows MSI (WiX v5) (optional, windows) | `dotnet tool install --global wix --version 5.0.2` |
